narration: In month {fork_month}, two offers arrived, and you took {real_choice}. The ghost chose {ghost_choice}. In month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart. In month {layoff_month}, the layoff reached both lives at the widest point of the run, and the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month}, its lowest since the split, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's pay arrived with more of it already claimed, and its Freedom ended {freedom_gap}.
